semanticChecks: Observation distinguishes person words/actions, actual measured temperature/BP, perceived heat on touch and cause inference; unusual change alone is not cause determination. Footwear/hems/wet floor/cables/broken equipment distinct, yesterday ability not today guarantee, seated/lying movement and bed-equipment transfer risk, no age/disability-label blanket decisions.

Risk management predicts/prepares/prevents; near miss without injury still facts recorded/shared, context/event/confirmed factors/unconfirmed cause distinct and team response/recurrence prevention. Moving wheelchair and verified unengaged brake are conditional facts; before inspection no recorded confirmed brake cause.

Japanese teaching labels/readings for health/current state/face color, nausea versus actual vomiting, perspiration versus raised temperature, swelling versus edema, contracture versus temporary muscle effort, pressure injury beyond bedbound, heat illness versus sudden-temperature heat shock, pain/contextual distress, symptoms versus episode, cough/dizziness/numbness all retained; no vocabulary-only diagnosis or picture-inferred temperature.
Actual observations/responses follow personal state/individual plan/facility procedure, changes/risks to necessary recipient, no text-only uncertain technique trial.

Bacteria/virus/fungi/parasite pathogens; fever/vomiting/diarrhea/abdominal pain/rash/face change explicitly to medical professional, no symptom-only pathogen identification or apparently healthy exemption. Source/route/host with humans/animals, hands/objects/food and differing source reduction/route interruption/health support aims retained; feasible action need not wait for all three.

Contact examples norovirus/O157, droplet influenza, airborne TB/measles retained as learning classification, not one-pathogen-one-precaution sufficiency; pathogen/task/current facility guidance controls.

Standard precautions apply before diagnosis and consider blood/saliva/nasal fluid/vomit/urine/feces/broken skin/mucosa contacts. Gloves/mask/apron-gown/eye protection are task-risk choices, not universal kit. Gloves hand-contact/apron clothing/goggles splash risks, cap not always everyone, product-specific mask nose-mouth-chin coverage and other precautions retained.

Disposable glove change per procedure between persons/care/dirty-to-clean, no same pair across people; contaminated surface inward/removal/designated disposal/subsequent hand hygiene, glove not handwashing substitute. Congregate contacts require preventing facility entry/exit/internal spread with hygiene/items/environment/team procedure; low resistance consideration not healthy-person exemption.
PPE donning/doffing/contaminated processing/disinfection product-concentration-time are facility training/guidance, no new treatment procedure or disease created from lesson.

Both palms not proof of dorsum/interdigits/thumb/tips-nails/wrists; both hands checked, foam not completion. Running water/liquid soap whole wet→lather/wash necessary areas→adequate rinse→proper paper towel drying, watch/ring covered areas prepared under facility rules, washing around jewelry not always sufficient.

Palm rub/opposite dorsum with side change, interlaced fingers and finger dorsum, not dominant hand only; opposite-hand thumb wrap/rotation, tips-nails to opposite palm, both sides/wrists and trained actual force/procedure preserved.

Proper hand rub product amount/full coverage/rub until dry, cupped hand catches liquid but not amount proof, no intermediate water rinse/paper wipe. Visible dirt requires liquid soap/running water beyond alcohol alone, pathogen/task/facility differences; washing/rub are not automatically interchangeable. Recontact recontamination, clean/used locations/order, diagram knowledge not performance proof and direct training retained.

Body mechanics coordinated bones/joints/muscles, person protection and caregiver effort/lumbar load, one posture illustration not universal safe transfer. Base of support contact-point boundary, appropriate foot spread/low center, correctly used cane changes support boundary but not no-fall guarantee; person/device/floor conditions retained.

Work close to body/large leg-buttock muscle groups avoid lumbar-only load, no straight-knee lumbar lift or loaded lumbar twist, step feet/face travel direction. Limbs gathered within possibility, horizontal center movement/whole-body movement/lever fulcrum-force/distance effects, no knowledge-only body-fulcrum choice or joint tying/painful forced posture.

Pull explanation not skin drag over bedding or affected-arm pulling. Friction-reducing assisted horizontal movement differs from direct body dragging; skin/pain/person capability/device conditions. Personal ability/lift/sliding sheet versus board/trained team considered, total-assist transfer posture not permission for solo manual lift, suitable device/method prioritized, similar names not same suitability/use.

Worker nutrition/sleep/moderate exercise/rest and time/rhythm, no solitary worry, colleagues/senior-experience consultation and personal stress coping. Unwell/excess load reported and support adjusted rather than forced work. Transfers/repositioning require person assessment/individual plan/device instructions/practical training; foot spread/principle memory no permission for unpractised operation.

Disaster-specific earthquake/typhoon/fire risks and routine facility plan/evacuation routes/contacts/community cooperation with assigned who helps whom before event. All stock examples retained including individual medicines/medical/first aid/light/radio-batteries/warmth/clothes/hygiene/head protection/cash/documents, personal needs/management/plan/deadlines, not universal amounts/items or complete picture inventory.

Drills cover unavailable normal route/mobility-assistance assignments/failed-contact alternatives, record actual place/person/state, packed bag not evacuation completion. Oxygen concentrator/electric device outage contacts/support/spares/power agreed ahead with medical and equipment staff, specific person/device/plan, no staff-derived connection/flow setting. Item list versus roles/contacts/device preparations/movement plan/usable system distinct.

Communication mutual thoughts/emotions/information/understanding, speaker-listener roles alternate, staff finished speech not listener understanding proof. Speech/writing/sign language verbal, sign language not free gesture; expression/posture/gaze/gesture nonverbal checked individually.

Attentive accurate listening, perspective-based empathy and accepting feeling/opinion distinct, no staff-right-conclusion conformity. Closed yes-no/limited choices concrete check, open questions broad person thought/wish, closed-only one-way risk and repeated why potentially blaming despite open form; purpose/burden guide choice.

Values era/upbringing/environment/experience, respectful adult-to-adult talk and necessary mutual clarification with person/family/other professionals retained. Event refusal repeated why not automatically good open question, pause/listen/brief clarification if needed, question shape not communication guarantee.

Restatement shows listening/checks mismatch while retaining when/body site/personal feeling and no staff conclusion substitution, yesterday not today. Face person/gaze level/pace/calm voice/wait adapted; crossed arms/leaning away may seem inattentive but individual/cultural differences prevent universal forced gaze/posture.

Distance/touch meaning varies by person/situation/manner/force/count; hand holding not universal closeness and cultural tendency not personal wish substitute. Choices and each benefit/disadvantage explained understandably; support thinking/choosing/expressing will/respect decision, purpose explained not consent obtained.

Nod before disadvantage explanation not all-understanding/consent evidence, supplement necessary info/check actual understanding/choice, consent tied to explained assistance scope. Actual care follows person/plan/facility and unconfirmed consent/unimplemented support not completed records. All28rationales keep each option-specific reason, no generic replacements.
